tool_input.description: Create files, run tests, smoke-test server

tool_input.command: node --test 2>&1 | tail -9; node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " http://127.0.0.1:5173/; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:5173/config.js; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " http://127.0.0.1:5173/app.js; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5173/nope; kill $PID
tool_input.description: Run unit tests and smoke-test server routes
